name: V. Jesse Smith
office: City of Palmdale, Member of the City Council, 5th District

items.text: V. Jesse Smith is a labor representation specialist. He served four years on the Palmdale Planning Commission. As a commissioner, he decided on conditional use permits, housing proposals, and updates to land-use laws and regulations. He also serves as a hearing officer for parking citations in Palmdale. In 2013, Smith was a plaintiff in a California Voting Rights Act lawsuit that blocked the city from certifying an at-large council election, which a court found diluted Latino and African-American votes. He chairs the Antelope Valley African-American Leadership Council.
